implementationNotes: Definitions preserve modern color-mix overrides; sourceRules preserve fallback order and conditions.
The hairline .5px declaration applies only at resolution >= 2x. Kit uses 1px fallback otherwise.
Kit onboarding is normalized on top of light, unlike the source partial override over dark.
Kit rebinds aliases per theme scope to avoid inherited alias values becoming stale.
Domain token names are source names; actual usage of unobserved tokens is not claimed.
Optional enhanced contrast is an independent recommendation; observed color pairs include secondary text below 4.5:1.
Observed alert text is blue-600 at 12px/16px; invalid context border uses link blue-500.
